{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Tree Branch Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Tree Branch Model.png|320x320px]] |Sprite BotW= [[File:BotW Tree Branch Icon.png|320x320px]] |Sprite TotK= [[File:TotK Tree Branch Icon.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC, AoI |cost= |value= |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 2 |TotK= 2 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 4 |TotK= 4 }} |comp= [[Deku Stick]] |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Tree Branch|Tree Branches|Series, BotW, AoC, AoI|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC, AoI}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 2 |durability = 4 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Tree Branch}} Tree Branches are [[One-Handed Weapon]]s that can be found near [[Tree]]s or bushes. They are flammable and will catch [[Fire]] if exposed to open flames or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Tree Branches are also not made of magnetic materials and cannot be manipulated with [[Magnesis]]. They do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s, and they do not conduct [[Electricity]] either. They will float in sufficiently deep bodies of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. When thrown with the [[Button|R Button]], Tree Branches will leave [[Link]]'s hand. On one of the central supports of the [[Bridge of Hylia]], Link can find a Tree Branch serving as a [[Natural Hiding Spot]]. When he picks this Tree Branch up, a [[Korok]] will appear and give him a [[Korok Seed]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Sword_044" |Life = 4 |Power = 2 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 1 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 2 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 2 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.0 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 1 |BuyingPrice = 3 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = One-Handed Weapon |strength = |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Tree Branch}} Two varieties of Tree Branches appear in {{TotK}}. The type found in {{BotW}} can be found on the [[Surface]], while a new type made of lighter wood can be found on [[Sky Island]]s. Like in {{BotW|-}}, they can be used as [[Weapon]]s. [[Link]] can also [[Fuse]] [[Object]]s, [[Material]]s, and other Weapons to Tree Branches. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link One-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} The Tree Branch is a weak [[Weapon]] that is accompanied by a [[Pot Lid]] as a [[Shield]] and a [[Wooden Bow]]. This Weapon can be obtained as early as the first stage simply by chopping down a few [[Tree]]s. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where the Item is found * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} Tree Branches return in {{AoI}} as [[One-Handed Weapon]]s. As a result, they can be wielded by the [[Knight Construct]], [[Typhan]], [[Lago]], [[Vence]], or [[Sholani]]. If Typhan is carrying a Tree Branch, his [[Shield]] will be an [[Old Wooden Shield]]. ==Trivia== *In {{TotK|-}}, due to their base [[Durability]] being less than seven, Tree Branches will display a low durability warning when they have two durability or less, instead of the standard three. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:TotK Tree Branch Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}Model of a Tree Branch from the Surface File:TotK Tree Branch Icon 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}Icon of a Tree Branch from the Surface File:AoC Tree Branch Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Tree Branch ==See Also== {{See Also| * Deku Stick * Twig * Weapon }} {{Ref| {{Cite|{{Big|Tree Branch}}
